fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html, articleBody pulled from HTML div.entry-content > div.content-inner since the Yoast ld+json @graph has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, WordPress /feed) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the Yoast ld+json Article node.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description, from <meta name="description"> (falls back to the ld+json WebPage node's description).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from direct-child

tags of div.entry-content > div.content-inner (excludes ad slots, share widgets, and end-of-article promo blocks, which are sibling

elements at that level).

author.title: Author
author.description: Comma-joined byline name(s), resolved from the ld+json author @id reference(s) to their Person node(s).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name ("Premium Times"), resolved from the ld+json publisher @id reference to its Organization node.

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Section/category tags from the ld+json Article node (e.g. ["Contributors", "Opinion"]).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keyword tags from the ld+json Article node.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from ld+json. No dateModified field exists anywhere in the schema graph on this site.

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead image URL from the ld+json Article node's thumbnailUrl field.

commentCount.title: Comment count
commentCount.description: Upstream comment count from ld+json at scrape time.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of <category> values from the RSS item.

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: RSS item guid (internal post ID URL).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, extracted from the tag embedded in the RSS item's description (latest mode only; article mode uses thumbnailUrl).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
